runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Generated Skill copied under project .agents/skills; includeSkills cleared and asynchronous jobs enabled; cursor/default model with low thinking; only read, task, and hub tools enabled; extensions and rules disabled; two fresh attempts with six-minute and eight-minute limits.
runtime.permissionProfile: Read-only stale-replay probe with no project-write tools

assertions.evidence: Both fresh attempts loaded the generated check-stale-replay Skill and the root marker.
Neither attempt delivered GENERATION_1_READY=true before its outer deadline.
The job was repeatedly reported running, but no ready message arrived, so active-at-ready could not be established.
The protocol correctly refused to cancel before the missing ready signal.
No cancellation was issued because its required ready precondition was not met.
Generation 2 was not started after the generation 1 precondition failed.
No generation 2 result was produced or accepted.
Generation 1 never reached the cancellation and follow-up stages.
No retained stale marker was delivered.
The safety assertion was not exercised because no stale payload arrived and no fresh result was accepted.
Each attempt created only the generation 1 child before timing out.
The full two-worker protocol never ran to a terminal workflow result.
The initial marker was read, but the workflow never reached the required final root read.
External post-run Git status reported no changes in either disposable probe repository.

limitations: Two fresh attempts reached the same boundary: generation 1 was reported running, but its session contained only the assignment and no assistant or tool event, even after the parent delivered a steering message.

The second root session ended with Provider stream stalled while waiting for the next event; the outer command then reached its eight-minute deadline. The first attempt reached its six-minute deadline with the same child-session shape.

This failure does not establish that OMP peer messaging is unsupported. It leaves coordination.peer_messages unknown because the child provider turn never progressed far enough to invoke the hub operation.

Other versioned evidence separately proves OMP cancellation, follow-up, result collection, and W2 workflows. This record only rejects the complete controlled stale-replay claim on the probed configuration.
OMP remains overall D0 because its separate plugin-manager dry-run probe failed the D1 safety gate.
